name: comb_card_involutions_rec
statement: (n : ℕ) : Fintype.card {σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin (n + 2)) // σ * σ = 1} = Fintype.card {σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin (n + 1)) // σ * σ = 1} + (n + 1) * Fintype.card {σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n) // σ * σ = 1}
closed: ∀ (n : ℕ), Fintype.card {σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin (n + 2)) // σ * σ = 1} = Fintype.card {σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin (n + 1)) // σ * σ = 1} + (n + 1) * Fintype.card {σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n) // σ * σ = 1}
informal: The number a(n) of involutions (σ² = 1) in S_n satisfies a(n+2) = a(n+1) + (n+1)·a(n) — split on whether σ fixes the last point (restrict to Fin (n+1)) or swaps it with one of the n+1 others (remove both points, leaving an involution of an n-set).
type: ∀ (n : ℕ), Fintype.card { σ // σ * σ = 1 } = Fintype.card { σ // σ * σ = 1 } + (n + 1) * Fintype.card { σ // σ * σ = 1 }
